progression.narrative: The performance opens on Fk4 and dwells most on Ak in Daramad I. The line peaks at Fk4 (326.2 Hz) at 0:48.1. It closes on the tonic (Fk4 → Fk4 → Ak3 → C4 → Ak3 → G3).
